title: Pair sum in a sorted array
description: Given a sorted array of integers and a target, return the indices of the two numbers that add up to the target as a tuple (i, j) with i < j. Exactly one valid pair exists.
hint: Start one pointer at each end. If the sum is too big, move the right pointer in; if it is too small, move the left pointer out. The array being sorted is what makes this valid.
